name: DBS Stainless Steel Fabricators
description: Established in 1985, DBS Stainless Steel Fabricators has become a trusted name in Metal Fabrication, specializing in custom stainless steel products for the Cincinnati Tri-State Area and beyond. Our range of expertise encompasses Restaurant Equipment, Industrial Parts, and Residential Countertops, ensuring we can meet the unique needs of diverse industries. DBS understands the demanding nature of the Restaurant Industry and offers a wide selection of solutions, from Chef's Counters to Wall Panels and Corner Guards, assisting our clients in creating custom and durable workspaces. With over 40 years of experience, our commitment to delivering superior quality products, and exceptional service sets us apart as the leading innovators in our field.

name: DG Medical
description: Although the name DG Medical was only adopted in 2010, the plastics molding expertise of the DG Medical team has been going strong for more than 30 years as part of the long-established DimcoGray Corporation, who specializes in the manufacture of thermoplastic and thermoset commercial and industrial knobs and handles. Having long been a trusted supplier of superior quality plastic molded components to many of the world’s leading medical device OEMs for years, establishing DG Medical as a full service contract manufacturer of medical devices was a natural off-shoot. Today, DG Medical is FDA Registered and ISO 13485 registered. DG Medical understands medical polymers, mold design and plastic molding processes, so our seasoned team of medical molding experts provides you with the best solution for bringing your product from conception design to production.

name: Dakota Metal Solutions LLC
description: Dakota Metal Solutions LLC is a high-precision metal fabrication and automated contract manufacturing company based in Summit, South Dakota, serving OEMs across the Upper Midwest. Equipped with advanced Bystronic 6kW/8kW fiber lasers, automated TRUMPF press brakes, Okuma CNC machining centers, and integrated multi-axis robotic welding cells, Dakota Metal Solutions specializes in scalable, lights-out production for sheet metal, tube, and heavy plate up to 1 inch thick. From collaborative DFM engineering and custom fixture fabrication to structural weldments and turnkey assembly, the company delivers exceptional repeatability, tight tolerances, and cost-effective OEM manufacturing solutions.
